title: SPSS Signal, Python Side
summary: Read an SPSS .sav file with pyreadstat: value labels, applying them, and declared-missing codes.
hints: `import pyreadstat`, then `teach, meta = pyreadstat.read_sav("teaching_study.sav")`: it returns two things.
`meta.variable_value_labels["method"]` is a dict of codes and labels. For labels in the data: `pyreadstat.read_sav("teaching_study.sav", apply_value_formats=True)`.
